title: Card sound hooks for triggered effects
notes: R5188000: cards may carry sounds for six recurring hooks (startOfTurn, endOfTurn, whenever, activate, hurt, hit), any voiced hook may give a pool of lines and an effect may be a list played in order; the card inspector's voice preview (apps/web/src/cards/inspect/VoicePreview.tsx) labels the six new hooks. Effect-only proof hooks on Gravedigger (start of turn), Combo-Index (end of turn), Fed Fauci (Whenever) and Unstable Clone Machine (Activate). R5188001: the voice budget is 32 MiB, with a four-word cap on new lines, a gzip cap on the sound tables and a census. No voice line is written or rendered, and no card plays differently.

player.title: Cards that sound when their effects trigger
new: Gravedigger, Combo-Index, Fed Fauci and Unstable Clone Machine now make a sound when their start-of-turn, end-of-turn, Whenever or Activate effect runs.
